about_the_game:
Take to the skies and get a first taste of the adventure! The Sky Bound Hero Demo lets you experience the core gameplay and exploration that define the full game.

🕹 What’s included in the demo:

  • Explore a portion of the New York and Paris-inspired level.

  • Try out the main hero’s flight.

  • Discover the feel of the world, visuals, and controls before diving into the full game.

⚔️ This demo is designed to give you a glimpse of the action, while leaving plenty more to discover in the full adventure.

Are you ready to soar above the city and become a true Sky Bound Hero?

Please Note: Sky Bound Hero makes use of Cesium for Unreal with Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles to stream real-world map data. Because of this, an active internet connection is required to play the game. Performance may vary depending on your connection speed and stability.

Google Maps data is provided under license from Google and is used for visualization purposes only. All real-world map data and imagery remain the property of their respective owners.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD 2.5 GHz or superior
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any DirectX 11 or 12 compatible card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
